Hi Susan —

Great to meet you on the call yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture a lightweight implementation playmap so we can lock the first two weeks of tasks before the formal kickoff. Attached are a diagram (whitestone-vpc-diagram-v1.pdf) and a draft playmap (whitestone-implementation-playmap.xlsx).

High level asks to unblock scheduling: 
- Confirm the primary network contact for CIDR exchange and firewall rules (we need both VPC peering and the private endpoint CIDRs).
- Confirm whether Whitestone will accept our on-prem package or if you prefer the VPC+private endpoint only.
- Share any maintenance blackout windows the week of Jul 17 (we want to avoid any change windows).

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45 minutes):
1) Introductions & scope
2) Network handoff (CIDRs, peering, private endpoint hostnames)
3) On-prem package review & schedule (if required)
4) Rollout plan and success criteria

Would Thu Jul 12 10:00–10:45 PT or Fri Jul 13 09:00–09:45 PT work for your team?

Thanks — I’ve looped in Monica (implementation lead) who will run technical onboarding.

Best,
Camila Reyes

FYI — netops here. Quick technical notes ahead of Thu: 
- CIDRs we will use for peering (prod/stage): 10.20.0.0/16 (prod), 10.21.0.0/16 (stage).
- Our edge sits behind a corporate HTTP proxy for outbound TLS inspection. We will provide a bypass list for the private endpoint IPs. Expect to allow 3 IPs per region initially.
- We prefer the private endpoint hostname pattern: api.private.whitestone.internal (wildcard cert already available). If Redwood requires specific SANs, please list them now.
- If you bring the on-prem package later, note that our on-prem team requires a maintenance window of 4 hours for appliance install; target weekends only.

Quick validation request: Vivek, can you confirm that our 10.20/10.21 ranges do not conflict with Redwood peering ranges? If so, we can proceed to establish the peering connection and exchange VPC peering attachment IDs during the call.

—Marco
